content.value: No probabilities are known for the occurrence of future states. Determine the solutions by the following criteria:

Farmer McCoy can plant either corn or soybeans. The probabilities that the next harvest prices of those commodities will grow up, state the same, or go down are 0.35, 0.40, and 0.25 respectively. If the prices grow up, the corn crop will net \$35,000 and the soybeans will net \$15,000. If the prices remain unchanged, McCoy will (barely) break even. But if the prices go down, the corn and soybeans crops wili sustain losses of \$25,000 and \$10,000, respectively. Which crop should McCoy plant?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2019
